title: Aminoguanidine-based bioactive proligand as AIEE probe for anticancer and anticovid studies.
authors: Mohammed Hashim, K K; Manoj, E
one_liner_zh: 该文研究一种氨基胍类生物活性前配体作为AIEE探针，涉及与小牛胸腺DNA的结合实验和对接，但核心是抗癌/抗新冠药物开发，非TF-DNA互作建模，AI/物理模拟方法仅限简单对接，匹配度低。
abstract: The emission features of a novel bioactive compound, 1,3-bis(2-hydroxy-3,5-diiodophenyl-methylideneamino)guanidine is found impressive with aggregation induced emission enhancement. The nitrogen and iodine rich multidentate proligand was characterized physicochemically. SCXRD and Hirshfeld surface investigation have revealed the presence of significant triangular iodine bonding apart from hydrogen bonding, weak C-Hcdots, three dots, centeredpi and picdots, three dots, centeredpi intermolecular interactions. These interactions collectively contribute to the solid-state packing arrangement of the molecules within the crystal lattice. The band gap of the compound was estimated experimentally and is supported with theoretical calculations. The solid-state fluorescence quantum yield of Phi = 0.36 emphasizes the utility of the proligand and the AIEE characteristics is attributed to restricted intramolecular motions as indicated by fluorescence lifetime decay studies. Strong interaction of the compound with calf thymus DNA was explored experimentally and found to align with in silico docking results. Notably, in vitro anticancer assessment on MCF-7 breast cancer cells show an IC(50) value of 181.05 mug mL(-1) and signifying its potent cytotoxic properties. Also, the compound is found to have lesser cytotoxicity against L929 normal cell line with an IC(50) value of 356.54 mug mL(-1). Computational studies further underscore the exceptional binding affinity with active sites in the SARS-CoV-2 main protease 3CL(pro), surpassing established repurposed drugs. Furthermore, the proligand demonstrates excellent putative affinity towards the SARS-CoV-2 spike glycoprotein, accompanied by its distinctive AIEE attributes, drug likeness and DNA binding capability rendering it a valuable tool for prospective research investigations.
abstract_zh: 一种新型生物活性化合物1,3-双(2-羟基-3,5-二碘苯基亚甲基氨基)胍的发射特性令人印象深刻，具有聚集诱导发射增强效应。该富含氮和碘的多齿前配体经过物理化学表征。SCXRD和Hirshfeld表面研究揭示了除氢键、弱C-H···π和π···π分子间相互作用外，还存在显著的三角形碘键。这些相互作用共同促进了分子在晶格内的固态堆积排列。该化合物的带隙通过实验估算，并得到理论计算的支持。固态荧光量子产率Phi = 0.36强调了该前配体的实用性，而AIEE特性归因于受限的分子内运动，如荧光寿命衰减研究所指示。该化合物与小牛胸腺DNA的强相互作用通过实验探索，并与计算机模拟对接结果一致。值得注意的是，对MCF-7乳腺癌细胞的体外抗癌评估显示IC(50)值为181.05微克每毫升，表明其具有强效细胞毒性。此外，该化合物对L929正常细胞系的细胞毒性较低，IC(50)值为356.54微克每毫升。计算研究进一步强调了其与SARS-CoV-2主蛋白酶3CL(pro)活性位点的卓越结合亲和力，超过了已确立的再利用药物。此外，该前配体对SARS-CoV-2刺突糖蛋白表现出优异的推定亲和力，结合其独特的AIEE特性、药物相似性和DNA结合能力，使其成为前瞻性研究的有价值工具。
